commands.name: search-content
commands.summary: Full-text search of ssb.no content (statistics, articles, analyses, fact pages), with subject/content-type filters and date sort

commands.name: get-topic
commands.summary: List the sub-topics (category links) on an ssb.no main topic page

commands.name: get-statistic
commands.summary: Get a statistic page's overview: title, ingress, last and next update, subjects and keywords

commands.name: get-statistic-tables
commands.summary: Get the 'selected figures' tables shown on a statistic page (caption, header and rows as text)

commands.name: get-article
commands.summary: Get an ssb.no article: title, ingress, publish date, authors and body text

commands.name: search-tables
commands.summary: Search or list Statbank (PxWebApi v2) tables by keyword

commands.name: get-table
commands.summary: Get Statbank table info: label, period range, variables, subject paths, update time

commands.name: get-table-metadata
commands.summary: Get Statbank table metadata (json-stat2): dimensions with all value codes and labels, notes, roles

commands.name: get-table-default-selection
commands.summary: Get the default variable/value selection and layout the Statbank uses for a table

commands.name: get-table-data
commands.summary: Fetch Statbank table data (json-stat2). Without selections it returns the table's default selection.

commands.name: search-classifications
commands.summary: Search Klass, SSB's statistical classifications and code lists (e.g. NACE, municipalities, occupations)
